name: Neon
css: .popover, .popover.sheet { box-shadow: var(--docent-shadow); } .popover .arrow { border-color: oklch(87% 0.15 190 / 0.35) !important; } .eyebrow { color: oklch(76% 0.22 340); letter-spacing: 0.16em; } .title { text-shadow: 0 0 18px oklch(87% 0.15 190 / 0.35); } .button.primary { box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px oklch(87% 0.15 190 / 0.6), 0 0 18px -2px oklch(87% 0.15 190 / 0.7); } .marks i[data-done] { background: var(--docent-accent); box-shadow: 0 0 6px oklch(87% 0.15 190 / 0.8); }
